description.text: V Start Decks, nine 60-card decks released together on 10 July 2020, one for each type: Grass Venusaur, Fire Incineroar, Water Wailord, Lightning Pikachu, Psychic Mew, Fighting Lucario, Darkness Galarian Slowbro, Metal Duraludon and Colorless Eevee, each led by that Pokémon's Pokémon V. Like the GX Start Decks before them they came with only a sheet of damage counters and markers, no coin or playmat. This set holds the cards of all nine.
